# Copilot Studio What's New — captured 2026-08-07
# (source ms.date 2026-07-15; page updated_at 2026-08-03)

## June 2026 [EXPANDED — 6 entries added to this section since the 2026-07-08 capture]
Previously cached (already reported):
- New agent experience (production-ready preview) — GitHub Copilot harness, enhanced orchestration runtime.
- Microsoft IQ — connects an agent to org data: emails, calendar, files, Teams messages, people.
- Skills — modular reusable instruction sets; export as Markdown/package.
- Memory — persistent per-user context store.

NEW on the page this scan (backfilled into the June section after 2026-07-08):
- (GA) Windows 365 for Agents MCP server — full operational control of a Windows 365 Cloud PC:
  desktop interaction (mouse/keyboard/screen capture/command execution), browser automation via
  Microsoft Edge, semantic UI inspection via Windows UI Automation. sessionId-based sessions,
  30-min idle eviction. [REPORTED 2026-08-07]
- (Preview) Connect your agent to Foundry IQ — ground responses in an Azure AI Foundry knowledge
  base from the new agent experience. [REPORTED 2026-08-07]
- (Preview) Voice agents with Teams Phone Agent — handoff between Teams Phone Agent and a custom
  voice agent for billing / prescription refill / order-status call workflows. [REPORTED 2026-08-07]
- (Preview) Connect other agents in the new agent experience — front-door agent delegates to
  specialist agents. [REPORTED 2026-08-07]
- (GA) Claude Sonnet 5 or GPT-5.5 Chat selectable as an agent's primary AI model. [REPORTED 2026-08-07]
- Condition groups in Message/Question/prompt nodes (authoring convenience — below bar).
